messages:
Mira (CSM): FYI PineCo is W2 and hasn't sent a single API key rotation request or used the demo routes. Usage 0 for 7 days. low activity flag :warning:
OnboardingBot: Health score for PineCo dropped 78 -> 42 after inactivity window triggered (rule: 48h no-activity).
Mira (CSM): I sketched a small clutch rescue kit — want to try a micro-intervention before this hits renewal. thinking: (1) 30m live workshop w/ engineering template handover, (2) 2-week trial credit + onboarding engineer pairing, (3) tailored prompt templates and sample evals, (4) capture feedback via 3-question form.
Jon (CS Ops): +1. Do we have budget for credits? how much would you propose?
Mira (CSM): proposing $500 credit and 2x 1-hour pairing sessions. keep it narrow — focus on first 3 API calls and embedding pipeline.
Sam (Enablement): I can run the 30m workshop — have a condensed slide deck and quick lab. Can do Tue/Thu mornings. I’ll also drop a one-pager playbook for their PM.
Lex (Support): I'll create a priority ticket for engineering pairing and make sure we have an on-call rota if they hit errors during the session. need the account id.
Mira (CSM): Account: pineco-542. I'll DM the creds. Also want to capture the friction: dropdown on the form = [SDK issues, auth, docs clarity, infra], freeform box for specifics.
Dana (RevOps): Marking this as "at-risk - early intervention" for renewal telemetry. If activation doesn't change post-kit, we trigger a monthly check-in cadence and escalate to AM.
Jon (CS Ops): I'll approve the $500 credit; please file the credit request ticket with amount and link to customer convo.
Mira (CSM): filing it now — ticket #CSOPS-2917. tagging @Jon for approval in ticket.
OnboardingBot: Note added: intervention scheduled. Next check: +72h activity scan on 1876543540.
Sam (Enablement): Agenda for workshop draft: 1) Quick goals alignment (5m) 2) Key integration walkthrough (10m) 3) Live run of sample request + troubleshooting (10m) 4) Next steps & resources (5m). Can anyone grab internal notes template?
Lex (Support): Using OSS onboarding-template-v2. I'll paste snippets into the workshop doc.
Mira (CSM): Action owners: Mira = customer comms + feedback form; Sam = run workshop + slide deck; Lex = support ticket + pairing; Jon = credit approval; Dana = renewal flagging.
Mira (CSM): Expected success criteria: they run first 3 API calls in session + submit feedback form + one metric improvement (health >= 65) within 7 days.
Jon (CS Ops): Sound. If they decline workshop, fallback = 30-min async video + guided lab and a smaller $200 credit.
Sam (Enablement): I can record the async video same day if needed.
Mira (CSM): I'll send first outreach now. ping here when scheduled. small ask: capture verbatim feedback in the ticket so we can feed product/docs.
Dana (RevOps): Also, please add a boolean field to the customer record: "clutch_rescue_active" = true, and note start_ts = 1876543210. I'll use it for cohort reporting.
Mira (CSM): Done. outreach sent: "Hey PineCo — noticed onboarding stalled; can we book a 30m pairing? we have a short help kit + credit to unblock."
PineCo (Reply): Thanks Mira — Tue 10am PST works. Appreciate the help.
Mira (CSM): Scheduled. Sam can you confirm availability Tue 10am?
Sam (Enablement): Confirmed.
Lex (Support): Pairing slot blocked on calendar. I'll attach runbook.
Mira (CSM): Great — after the session I'll paste notes + feedback here. remember to capture the three-question form results: 1) What blocked you most? 2) Did the session solve it? 3) One improvement suggestion.
OnboardingBot: Reminder: post-session health scan scheduled at 1876543940.
Mira (CSM): Closing loop for now. If health doesn't improve after 7 days we'll move to an "activation sprint" with AM involvement. Thanks team :rocket:
